prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup. Refine ONE existing Ascend Studio screen, giving the decorative artwork MEANING RELATED TO EACH REGION'S FUNCTION.
Image 1 is the EXACT EDIT TARGET: preserve the current three-column structure, dense project/task sidebar, all navigation and task row positions, entire topbar/logo/breadcrumb, conversation text and right-aligned user bubble, AI plain text on background without bubble or avatar, free canvas objects/code/evidence, toolbar, minimap, and controls. Image 2 is color/material reference only: bright light pastel gradients, thin transparent glass/film, fine edge glints, gentle diffuse refraction, cyan/lavender/rose/coral/apricot/mint/buttery yellow. Do not copy its layout, French text, spheres or literal objects.
Target 1672 x 941, same landscape aspect as input. Current date anchor 2026-10-09; do not add dates.

User feedback: decorative forms should correspond to the FUNCTION of the area, not only its available space. The left area is PROJECTS and should feel like an archive through repeated planes. The middle is CONVERSATION and should have a stronger sense of mutual interaction. The right is a CANVAS and should suggest open space for unfolding content. Change decorative imagery only; keep existing UI geometry and content locked.

A. LEFT PROJECT ARCHIVE — Replace the lower-left pointed mountain-like fold with 7 or 8 REPEATED THIN FLAT PLANES. Orderly parallel translucent sheets, offset slightly like archived pages/dividers, a compact gently fanned or stepped arrangement anchored at the bottom left. Give it a calm structured cadence that suggests organized projects and collected material. The planes are abstract, unmarked, exceptionally thin, with pastel gradient transmission and shallow colored shadows. No pointed mountains. No actual folder tabs, file icons, labels, corner buttons or outlines that look operable. Artwork roughly 150 x 85 pixels, below the footer text and outside the task rows; partly crop at the bottom. Preserve compact project spacing.

B. MIDDLE RECIPROCAL CONVERSATION — Replace the single horizontal decorative wave with TWO DISTINCT OPEN, LIGHTWEIGHT CURVING SURFACES that extend toward each other from opposite directions. A cool cyan/lilac gesture moves in from the left, a warm coral/rose gesture moves in from the right; they overlap at different depths, weave lightly, and turn back in a small fluid response. Keep visible translucent space at their meeting point, with a subtle echo curve suggesting reply. This should feel like exchange, listening and responding, not one-way flow or a static landscape. Both ends remain open. NO literal speech bubbles, no enclosed capsules, no circles, no tails, no avatars, no arrows, no connection dots. Keep a low horizontal silhouette within the same narrow whitespace under the conversation heading and above the first user message. The interaction gesture is energetic yet refined; no enlarged header or moved message. All heading and message text stays on a clean white surface.

C. RIGHT OPEN CANVAS — Keep the outside right-edge decoration as a soft tall OPEN translucent curved sheet, with a light outward unfolding secondary edge. It conveys spatial expansion and room to develop content. A wide sweep is mostly outside the image, visible only as a narrow arc near the right border; softly diffuse toward the blank canvas margin. This shape must look spacious rather than archival or conversational. It does not surround, connect, or impersonate canvas objects. Keep code/evidence cards, toolbar, zoom controls and minimap entirely clear.

Use a common fine translucent material, gradient color sequence, soft studio daylight and restrained shadow to relate the three different semantic forms. Colors stay light and chromatically rich; no muddy gray, monochrome computing hardware, neon or dense rainbow background. Main UI remains warm white/light gray, neutral selected rows, charcoal text and compact typography. No sphere/pearl/jewelry, literal chip, graph node, matrix grid or profiling mark. No new feature, extra card, learning center, concept label, option number, device frame or browser chrome. Output ONE polished revised screen with only these illustration changes.
